title: Conditional Flat Exponential Directed Last Passage Percolation under a One-Point Upper Large Deviation Event
summary: Exponential directed last passage percolation is a random maximization model connected to tandem queues and interacting particle systems. We study the line-to-point model of the percolation, in which the starting point is allowed to vary inside a line boundary, conditioned on an atypically large last-passage time to a fixed endpoint.
